pr_title: Implement ADR 0136 preview asset residency and streaming
pr_body: Implements the first ADR 0136 residency/streaming slice: project-scoped preview CPU residency shared by Scene View and Animation Preview, background model materialization with in-flight dedupe and generation checks, exact background-import result publication, stale-generation rejection, and shared preview GPU mesh residency. This request preserves runtime synchronous conversion contracts and persisted Stable IDs/schema. Follow-up commits on the same branch complete device-scoped renderer warm-up, texture residency, upload budgeting/priorities, and final ADR verification.
